title: Although Memorial Day is against God's laws, did you know Black people started this tradition?
cleanTitle: Although Memorial Day is against God's laws, did you know Black people started this tradition?
segments: I'm starting to think they really don't
want us to know this because Memorial
Day, the one we celebrate with fireworks
and long weekends, it has black roots
that were never taught. After the Civil
War ended in 1865, Union soldiers had
been held prisoner at a racetrack in
Charleston, South Carolina. More than
250 of them died there. But the
Confederates just buried them in mass
graves. No names, no ceremony. So, 28
black men, newly freed from slavery,
spent 2 weeks digging them up and gave
every single soldier a proper burial.
They built a fence around the graves,
and above the entrance, they wrote
"Martyrs of the Race Course." Then on
May 1st, 10,000 people showed up. 3,000
black school children led the way
singing, carrying flowers, honoring
soldiers who died for their freedom,
making this the first Memorial Day. That
happened 3 years before the government
made it an official holiday.
